title: Calendar of missing days
statementMd:
Generate every calendar date from 2024-03-01 to 2024-03-10 with a recursive CTE and list those that have no price rows for any ticker. These are the weekends.

Expected columns: `missing_date`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH RECURSIVE cal(d) AS (SELECT '2024-03-01' UNION ALL SELECT date(d, '+1 day') FROM cal WHERE d < '2024-03-10') SELECT d AS missing_date FROM cal WHERE d NOT IN (SELECT trade_date FROM prices);
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
